PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (DELIMITATION
OF NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS AND VILLAGE
COUNCILS) RULES, 2022
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
31st January, 2022]
No.
SOR(LG)8-4/2021, dated 31.1.2022.---In
exercise of the powers conferred under section 213 read with section 10(1) of
the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2021 (XXVII of 2021), Governor of the
Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Punjab Local Government (Delimitation of
Neighbourhood Councils and Village Councils) Rules, 2022.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the rules, unless the subject or context
otherwise requires:
(a) "delimitation
authority" means an authority appointed under rule 7 of the rules;
(b) "delimitation
committee" means a committee appointed under rule 3 of the rules;
(c) "form"
means Form appended to the rules;
(d) "Ordinance"
means the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2021 (XXVII of 2021);
(e) "population"
means the population of a local area in accordance with the preceding census;
(f) "Provincial
Election Commissioner" means the Provincial Election Commissioner, Punjab;
and
(g) "rules"
means the Punjab Local Government (Delimitation of Neighbourhood Councils and
Village Councils) Rules, 2022.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as is assigned to it under the Ordinance.
3. Appointment
of delimitation committee.---(1)
The Election Commission shall appoint a delimitation committee for a district
or a part thereof from amongst the officers of the Election Commission,
Government or autonomous body controlled by the Government.
(2) The
delimitation committee shall delimit the Neighbourhood Councils and Village
Councils within the district or part thereof in accordance with the provisions
of the Elections Act, 2017 (XXXIII of 2017), Ordinance, rules and instructions
issued by the Commission.
4. Functions
of the delimitation committee.---(1)
The delimitation committee shall delimit the Neighbourhood Councils and Village
Councils in accordance with sections 10, 11 and 12 of the Ordinance.
(2) The
delimitation committee shall delimit the urban area in a district constituting
the defunct Metropolitan Corporation, Municipal Corporation, Municipal
Committee, Town Committee under the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of
2019) into Neighbourhood Councils, keeping in view the population criteria
given below:
(i) twenty
thousand in case of defunct Metropolitan Corporation and Municipal Corporation
under the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of 2019); and
(ii) fifteen
thousand in case of defunct Municipal Committee and defunct Town Committee
under the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of 2019).
Provided
that the average population in the hilly areas shall be ten thousand.
(3) The
delimitation committee shall delimit rural area in a District Council into
Village Councils, with an average population of twenty thousand:
Provided
that the average population in the hilly areas shall be ten thousand.
(4) The
delimitation committee shall delimit the Neighbourhood Councils and Village
Councils, as far as possible, equal in population among themselves. In case of
variation, difference shall not be more than ten percent without breaking any
census block and if it exceeds the ten percent, the delimitation committee
shall record reasons for such variation.
(5) The
local area of each Neighbourhood Council and Village Council shall be a
territorial unit.
(6) The
boundaries of a Village Council shall not cross the limits of the respective
tehsil in a district.
(7) The
boundaries of Neighbourhood Council shall not cross the limits of the
respective Metropolitan Corporation, defunct Municipal Corporation or Municipal
Committee or Town Committee constituted under the Punjab Local Government Act,
2019 (XIII of 2019), as the case may be.
